scripts.build: rm -rf dist/recordu && mkdir -p dist/recordu && cp -R manifest.json background.js content.js modal.js popup.html popup.js review.html styles.css icons review shared styles vendor dist/recordu/ && find dist/recordu -name .DS_Store -delete
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f recordu.zip && zip -r recordu.zip recordu
scripts.crx: npm run build && rm -f dist/recordu.crx && "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --pack-extension=dist/recordu --pack-extension-key=dist/key.pem
scripts.release: npm run zip && npm run crx && V=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && awk -v v="$V" '/^### /{if(seen)exit; if($2==v)seen=1; next} seen&&!/^## /{print}' README.md > dist/notes.md && [ -s dist/notes.md ] || echo "RecordU v$V" > dist/notes.md && gh release create "v$V" dist/recordu.crx dist/recordu.zip --title "v$V" --notes-file dist/notes.md && rm -f dist/notes.md && echo "Released v$V"
